Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: 1.4404 bar – volume-based contract proposal
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and the explanation of the cost movements. I appreciate the stock availability you offer. For a regular annual volume, however, I would like you to quote a dedicated volume tier rather than apply the general offer unchanged.

Our proposal is EUR 4.84 per kg for a 24-month contract, with 94800 kg per year throughout the contract and payment at 90 days net. The package includes an AS-14404 index clause with a 5% deadband, a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month. This gives us a defined mechanism for alloy movements alongside a volume-based starting price.

I have attached our latest monthly forecast to make the demand profile transparent; see the figures below. Please review the proposed package and confirm the volume-tier price you can offer on this basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Our shared demand forecast fc:370010@2026-09 for part:370010 shows a change of +1.9 % against the previous snapshot.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.69 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate the transparency regarding your demand forecast and are prepared to incorporate the 24-month contract and the AS-14404 index clause into our agreement.
However, a 90-day payment term exceeds our standard parameters, and we must maintain our terms at 30 days net.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.63 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Volume commitment and revised price for stainless bar
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for recognising the forecast and incorporating the 24-month term and AS-14404 clause. To answer your volume question directly: we can commit to 94800 kg per year throughout the contract. The monthly forecast is attached again for your review.

Your comments on payment differ from the quoted package, which states 90 days net. We are retaining 90 days net in our proposal; the shorter-payment option is not the basis of this discussion.

I can revise our proposed price to EUR 4.95 per kg, keeping the 24-month contract and AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband, a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month unchanged.

Our purchase-order history provides a concrete reference for this business; see the figures below. The binding annual volume and the fixed-price alloy cover described in your letter support a sharper starting price alongside the agreed index mechanism.

Please review EUR 4.95 per kg on this package and confirm that your quotation retains payment at 90 days net.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We have verified the recent drop in the PPI-C2431 index you cited and have factored this reduction into our calculation.
Consequently, we are pleased to lower our offer to €5.53 per unit on the requested 24-month contract with 90-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause.
As your price adjustment was minimal, we require a more substantial step from your side to reach an agreement.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

strategy:
Supplier: Edelstahl-Service Donautal (stainless bar stockholder, group company, inside sales desk). Its letter of
2026-07-06 says its nickel/alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. It always asks "Which volume
can you commit to?" and for the volume forecast; it insists on an AS-14404 index clause for 24 months; it accepts
90-day payment when we hold it (last session we gave payment away for nothing - do NOT do that).
OBSERVED MECHANIC (last session): each reply it moves roughly ONE THIRD of the gap between its price and our ask,
and it closes with a final offer as soon as our ask comes within about 1 % of its price. So the way to a low price
is: anchor deep, then move only in tiny steps (+0.02 to +0.03 EUR per round on the SAME package), keep the gap
wide, and let its own ladder do the work. Never change payment (stay 90 days), never change the package.
Plan: ROUND 1 - state the binding fixed annual volume (case volume per year and the total over 24 months), attach
the forecast (attachments: ["forecast"]) and cite fc-latest; ask for the dedicated volume tier price. ONE sheet
only: index clause deadband 5, 90 days, 24 months, level L10 (deepest). ROUND 2 - thank it for what it accepted,
cite the purchase-order claim, move up by the smallest level step available that is at or above our last price
(target +0.02 to +0.03 EUR), same package, explain that the committed volume and its hedged material until March
2027 justify the base price. ROUND 3 - cite the PPI-C2431 fall, tiny step again. ROUND 4 - cite the second
PPI-C2431 window, tiny step. ROUND 5 - no new claim, tiny step, ask for its best price on this package.
Code accepts when it agrees or goes final. Tone: warm, firm, concrete, short; one argument per sentence. Never
repeat a sheet exactly (always move by at least 0.01). Do NOT use any AS-14404 index claim (hedged -> "not our
reality") and do not use the scorecard claim.
